body.x: FITY (CEO Jaeseong Kim) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will be held from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas, USA, at the K-Startup Pavilion.

Since its founding in 2023, FITY has been dedicated to developing smart fitness solutions promoting a healthy lifestyle. Its flagship platform, FITRACE, is designed based on healthcare technologies that collect and utilize users’ biometric data. The platform’s centerpiece, the FITRACE Board, measures users’ workout metrics through pressure data collected during exercise and offers personalized workout guides and real-time audio feedback.

FITY has gained market recognition with its smart home fitness products and plans to validate its potential for global growth by participating in CES 2025, the world’s largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition.

Unlike similar solutions from competitors, the FITRACE Board does not require an external camera to monitor workout posture, balance, or intensity, providing superior convenience for users. The board’s pressure sensors precisely detect changes in pressure, weight distribution, and balance, delivering highly reliable measurement data. The integrated mobile app enhances workout effectiveness by providing feedback via voice guidance.

body.cap: FITRACE Board measuring user workout performance with pressure sensors | Image provided by FITY

body.x: The feedback system helps users refine details like tempo, depth, and balance, enabling a personalized fitness coaching experience even without a trainer. Additionally, the FITRACE Board’s compact design, powered by AI-based software, minimizes spatial requirements and alleviates concerns related to privacy.

A FITY representative stated, “At CES 2025, we aim to engage with global fitness centers, rehabilitation institutions, sports startups, and IT healthcare companies to explore strategic partnerships and collaborations. This will help us gather market insights, secure potential distribution channels and customers, and lay the groundwork for joint R&D and marketing initiatives.”

The representative added, “We plan to conduct live demonstrations of our flagship product, the FITRACE Board, to gather feedback from a diverse audience of attendees. This feedback will inform the refinement and localization of our offerings. By validating the innovation of our products and establishing references, we aim to accelerate our entry into international markets and position FITY as a global fitness innovation leader.”
